# Aman Sinha

> Senior product and platform leader in Bengaluru focused on enterprise platforms, AI-powered automation, data products, and customer experience.

Aman Sinha has 15+ years across product ownership, platform strategy, engineering, consulting, presales, and enterprise transformation. His portfolio documents work at global scale, including products supporting 200K+ endpoints, 34M+ monthly voice minutes, 100+ engineers across eight teams, and $8M+ in efficiencies and cost avoidance.
